name: ndbc-noaa
description: NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC): marine buoy and C-MAN weather observations. This CLI fetches latest observations, realtime and 5-day station data, and station metadata from NDBC's static data files.

commands.name: get-latest-observation
commands.summary: Get the most recent marine weather observation for one station (wind, waves, pressure, temperatures) as an RSS item with an HTML-formatted description

params.name: station
params.description: NDBC station ID. Five-character buoy IDs are lowercase or numeric, e.g. 44013 or 42001. C-MAN IDs look like bzbm3.

commands.name: get-realtime-data
commands.summary: Get realtime standard meteorological data for a station (about the last 45 days, newest first) as a whitespace-delimited text table: WDIR, WSPD/GST in m/s, WVHT in m, PRES in hPa, ATMP/WTMP/DEWP in de

params.name: station
params.description: NDBC station ID, e.g. 44013 or 42001. C-MAN IDs are uppercase here, e.g. BZBM3. Some stations, such as 41001, return 404.

commands.name: get-5day-data
commands.summary: Get the last 5 days of standard meteorological data for a station (newest first) as a whitespace-delimited text table: WDIR, WSPD/GST in m/s, WVHT in m, PRES in hPa, temps in degC; 'MM' means missing

params.name: station
params.description: NDBC station ID, e.g. 44013 or 42001. C-MAN IDs are uppercase, e.g. BZBM3.

commands.name: list-latest-observations
commands.summary: Get the latest observation for every reporting station in one whitespace-delimited text table (columns include STN, LAT, LON, WDIR, WSPD, GST, WVHT, PRES, ATMP, WTMP; m/s, m, hPa, degC; 'MM' means mis

commands.name: list-active-stations
commands.summary: List all active NDBC stations with ID, name, coordinates, owner, program, type and whether each reports met data

commands.name: get-station-table
commands.summary: Get the full station metadata table (ID, owner, type, hull, name, payload, location, timezone, forecast, note) as pipe-delimited text

notes: CloudFront blocks the HTML/PHP pages on www.ndbc.noaa.gov with 403. This includes station_page.php, the search pages and directory listings. Only the static data files used here are reachable.
The .spec and .ocean realtime files, historical stdmet files and the radial station search also return 403, so they are not included.
Text tables use two header lines starting with '#' (column names, then units). Missing values are written as 'MM'. Times are UTC.
Common columns: WDIR (deg), WSPD/GST (m/s), WVHT (m), DPD/APD (s), PRES (hPa), ATMP/WTMP/DEWP (degC), VIS (nmi), TIDE (ft).
Use list-active-stations or get-station-table to find station IDs. Not every active station has a realtime2 file; for example, 41001 returns 404.
The description field in get-latest-observation is an HTML fragment containing the observation time, location and measured values.
